message: The other day, I decided it was time to go through our family's emergency go-bags. I gathered the kids around, and instead of making it a chore, I turned it into a little cozy event. We pulled out snacks and made a picnic on the living room floor while we sorted through water supplies and important documents. It was a wonderful way to bond and prepare at the same time. Who knew organizing could feel so warm and fuzzy? 💕 How do you make preparedness fun in your home?
